kehan.name: Kehan
title: 星海救援
Star Rescue
heroTitle:
飞船探索 × 冰火战斗
比较两版，找到融合方向

Ship exploration × ice & fire
Compare both, then combine
intro: Kehan 想开大飞船、换小飞船，再用枪与冰魔法救回地球。两次实现各有长处：飞行过程更完整，或地面战斗更直接。
Kehan wanted a mothership, a shuttle, guns and ice magic to save Earth. Two implementations offer different strengths: a fuller journey or more direct ground combat.
decision: 保留两个最新版作对照：Claude 看探索流程，Astra 看战斗手感；明确各自短板，再确定怎么融合。
Retain both current builds: compare Claude’s journey with Astra’s combat feel, identify weaknesses, then define the merge.

name: A · 飞船探索版
A · Ship explorer
tag: 保留 · iPad 触控修订
subtitle: 真正驾驶母舰与穿梭机，再下到怪物星球。
Actually pilot the mothership and shuttle, then reach the planet.
detail: 保留小行星航行、安全区、换乘与降落。修正横向输入重复，左摇杆改为移动、右侧拖动视角；失败从当前阶段重试。
Keep asteroid flight, safe zone, transfer and landing. Correct duplicate lateral input; use the left stick to move and drag on the right to look. Retry the current stage.
strength: 探索过程完整，飞船是玩法，不只是过场。
The ship journey is gameplay, not just a cutscene.
limit: 原版转向与横移混合；本轮统一触控后仍需孩子实机反馈来继续调手感。
Original turning and strafing were mixed. Touch controls are revised, but child/device feedback is still needed for feel.

name: B · 冰火战斗版
B · Ice & fire
tag: 保留 · iPad 触控修订
subtitle: 登船、登陆、开枪、冰冻：更直接的第三人称战斗。
Board, land, shoot and freeze: a more direct third-person battle.
detail: 保留第三人称移动、跳跃、射击、冰冻和夺宝。航行仍偏过场；本轮补齐触屏暂停、输入释放、屏幕边距和低帧率时钟。
Keep third-person movement, jumping, shooting, ice and treasure. Flight is still mostly cinematic. This revision completes touch pause, input release, safe areas and elapsed-time simulation.
strength: 冰冻火球与战斗反馈更直接，适合对照体验操作手感。
Direct ice/fire feedback makes this a useful control-feel comparison.
limit: 主动驾驶内容不及飞船探索版；没有把简短过场称为完整飞行玩法。
Less active piloting than the explorer branch. Short cinematics are not described as a full flight game.

requirements: 世界与目标
World & goal
地球陷入危机，探险家从怪物星球带回能量宝物。
Earth is in danger. Recover an energy relic from the monster planet.
飞行旅程
The journey
大飞船 → 安全区 → 小飞船 → 怪物星球。两个版本在“主动驾驶”上不同，必须让家长看得出来。
Mothership → safe zone → shuttle → monster planet. The branches differ in active piloting; that distinction must remain visible.
战斗与防御
Combat & defence
第三人称跑动、后退、跳跃与枪击；冰魔法冻结普通和巨大火球。
Third-person movement, reverse, jump and shooting. Ice freezes ordinary and giant fireballs.
结局与重试
Endings & retry
打败巨大 Boss、拿到宝物、拯救地球；失败可再次挑战。飞船版新增当前阶段重试。
Defeat the giant boss, recover the relic and save Earth. Failure offers retry; the flight branch now retries the current stage.
家庭使用
At home
iPad 直接打开网页；不需要老师的电脑开机，不需要多人房间。横屏优先，也检查竖屏布局。
Open the website directly on iPad. No teacher computer or multiplayer room is needed. Landscape is preferred; portrait layout is also checked.
timeline: 同一份课堂 brief，同时交给两个开发工具。
The same classroom brief was given to both development tools.
Claude 走完整飞行探索路线；Astra 更快形成直接的第三人称战斗。两者不是同一个成果的简单旧版与新版。
Claude built the complete flight journey; Astra delivered more direct third-person combat. They are distinct alternatives, not merely an old and new copy.
REVIEW
教师指出：Claude 飞船更完整但手感弱；Astra 飞船简陋但战斗更直接。上一轮只开放 Astra 是错误的取舍。
Teacher review: Claude’s ships are richer but controls weaker; Astra’s voyage is sparse but combat more direct. Publishing only Astra was the wrong selection.
R3 · INPUT
飞船横向输入去重；地面移动与转向分离；双指移动与射击；取消触摸或失焦时释放输入。
Remove duplicate flight input; separate ground movement and turning; allow two-finger move/fire; release controls on cancellation or focus loss.
R3 · HOME
两个分支统一暂停、语言切换、屏幕安全区；飞船版按关卡重试。保留两种玩法，不宣称已经完全融合成一个新游戏。
Unify pause, language and safe-area controls; add stage retry to the flight branch. Preserve both play styles rather than claiming a fully merged game.
R4 · TOUCH
工具栏统一改为左侧竖排，为摇杆留出独立空间；增加游戏表面的防双击缩放与非被动触摸防护，不影响普通按钮和名字输入。
Move utilities to a vertical left rail with a separate joystick zone; add gesture CSS and non-passive touch protection on game surfaces while preserving normal controls and name entry.
changes: 飞船会横着冲得过猛
Over-strong lateral steering
原版左右量被重复累计。现在只计算一次摇杆横向输入。
Lateral input was accumulated twice. It is now applied once.
移动和转视角混在一起
Movement and turning were mixed
左摇杆平移，右侧拖动视角；键盘 WASD 移动、Q/E 转向。
Left stick moves; right-side drag looks. Keyboard WASD moves; Q/E turns.
长流程失败后重来太累
Retry repeated too much
飞船版从当前航行、降落或星球阶段重新挑战。
Retry the current voyage, descent or planet stage.
家庭 iPad 操作不完整
Incomplete iPad controls
暂停、语言、方向变化、输入取消与安全区统一整理；不要求键盘或联机后端。
Consolidate pause, language, rotation, input cancellation and safe areas. No keyboard or network game server is required.
工具栏遮挡与双击缩放
Toolbar overlap and double-tap zoom
三个保留版本使用左侧工具栏。游戏手势不再交给浏览器缩放，双指移动、攻击和普通按钮另行回归。
All three retained builds use the left utility rail. Game gestures are protected from browser zoom; multi-touch play and ordinary controls are checked separately.
guide: 飞船探索版：左摇杆驾驶飞船；登陆后左摇杆移动、右侧空白画面拖动转视角。右侧三个按钮分别为跳跃、冰冻、射击，可边移动边射击。冰火战斗版：先点开始，用左摇杆走近小飞船，再点登船；登陆后用跳跃、冰冻和射击按钮。左侧工具栏可暂停、切语言及尝试全屏。

Ship explorer: steer with the left stick. On the planet, move with the left stick and drag the empty right side to look. Jump, Freeze and Shoot work while moving. Ice & fire: start, approach the shuttle with the stick, then tap Board. On landing, use Jump, Freeze and Shoot. The left-side toolbar offers pause, language and optional fullscreen.
questions: 哪一版让你更像在驾驶飞船？
Which branch feels more like piloting a ship?
哪一版的冰冻更容易瞄准？
Which ice control is easier to aim?
只选一个改进，你会保留哪一版的什么功能？
For one next improvement, what would you borrow from each branch?

sources.label: r3 · 版本与手感 / branches & feel

title: 先确定一条救地球的冒险路线
Define a journey to save Earth
summary: Kehan 的目标不是只有一场打怪，而是先旅行、再登陆、最后夺宝。
Kehan’s goal was a journey, a landing and a relic—not just an isolated fight.
brief: 大飞船 → 安全区 → 小飞船 → 怪物星球；失败重试，拿到宝物救地球。
Mothership → safe zone → shuttle → monster planet; retry failure and recover the relic.
tool: 课堂讨论整理成一份可执行 brief
Class discussion consolidated into one executable brief
tech: 拆成场景阶段、胜负状态、操作动作
Define scene stages, win/lose states and player actions
result: 两个工具得到同样目标，并有 15 分钟开发限制。
Both tools received the same goal and a 15-minute deadline.

title: 同一份需求，分成两条实现路线
One brief, two implementations
summary: 两边都复用了本地 Three.js 资源，但组织代码和分配时间的方式不同。
Both reused local Three.js assets, but organized the implementation differently.
brief: 必须第三人称；枪打怪、冰冻火球、能跑跳后退。
Third-person view, guns, frozen fireballs, running, jumping and reversing.
tool: Claude：Bash 检查环境 → Workflow 并行模块 → 集成；Astra：exec 调用 → 写场景／状态机 → 测试
Claude: Bash checks → parallel Workflow modules → integration; Astra: exec calls → scenes/state machine → tests
tech: Claude：独立场景与 UI 脚本；Astra：ES modules + Three.js + JavaScript 状态机
Claude: separate world/UI scripts; Astra: ES modules, Three.js and a JavaScript state machine
result: 飞船探索与冰火战斗成为两个不同的候选，而不是同一个游戏的前后备份。
Ship exploration and ice/fire combat emerged as separate candidates, not old/new backups.

title: 把母舰与穿梭机做成主动驾驶
Make the ships actively playable
summary: 保留驾驶、避开小行星、穿过安全区和降落，再切到星球战斗。
Pilot, dodge asteroids, reach the safe zone and descend before the ground battle.
brief: “先用大飞船到安全区，再坐小飞船”必须在游戏中看得见。
The mothership-to-shuttle journey must be visible in the game.
tool: 模块装配 → 启动本地预览 → 截图读取 → 阶段与结算脚本检查
Assemble modules → local preview → screenshot inspection → stage/ending scripts
tech: 本地 Three.js；分阶段逻辑；DOM 血条、卡片与触屏控件
Local Three.js, stage logic, DOM HUD/cards/touch controls
result: 探索完整度成为长处；教师试玩指出移动与转向手感还不够好。
Journey completeness is the strength; teacher play identified weak movement/turning feel.

title: 把冰冻与射击做成更直接的交互
Prioritize direct ice-and-gun feedback
summary: 将更多实现集中到地面战斗；母舰旅行主要是过场。
More implementation went into ground combat, while the voyage remained mainly cinematic.
brief: 普通火球与 Boss 大火球都能被冻结；打倒 Boss 再夺宝。
Freeze ordinary and giant boss fireballs, defeat the boss, then claim the relic.
tool: 写入 game.js → Playwright 测试 → 读取登陆／战斗／结局截图 → 回执
Write game.js → Playwright tests → landing/combat/ending screenshots → receipt
tech: 程序化场景、第三人称相机、投射物与碰撞、状态机
Procedural scenes, third-person camera, projectiles/collisions and states
result: 操作反馈更直接，但不能拿短过场代替完整飞船探索。
More direct controls, but short cinematics do not replace full ship exploration.

journey.date: 课后 · 对照与家庭适配
title: 纠正只保留一版，分别打磨两版
Restore both builds and improve each
summary: 最初归档偏向 Astra；教师明确要求两版都留下，为后续融合提供比较。
The initial archive favored Astra; the teacher asked to retain both for a future merge.
brief: 在家用 iPad 单机玩；保留两个不同长处。
At-home iPad solo play, with both distinct strengths preserved.
tool: 读候选与反馈 → 修触控输入 → 断网单机检查 → 重建双分支下载包
Read candidates/feedback → fix touch input → solo checks → two-branch ZIP
tech: 左摇杆与转视角分离、输入取消、暂停、阶段重试
Separate movement/look, cancel input, pause and stage retry
result: 两张可玩卡片；每个分支只保留最新版。
Two playable cards, with one current release per branch.

title: 解决界面遮挡和连点放大
Address overlap and repeated-tap zoom
summary: 工具栏从底部移到左侧；手势保护不能破坏双指移动和射击。
Move tools from bottom to left; gesture protection must preserve two-finger play.
brief: 工具栏不能挡按钮，连续点按不能放大页面。
Tools must not cover controls, and repeated taps must not zoom the page.
tool: 共享组件修复 → WebKit/Chrome 点按与布局 → 双指专项 → 解压包核验
Shared fix → WebKit/Chrome gestures/layout → multi-touch test → extracted ZIP checks
tech: touch-action、限定区域触摸兜底、safe-area、带版本号的资源
touch-action, scoped gesture fallback, safe areas and versioned assets
result: 网页与包已验证；实体 iPad 的完整长流程仍需最终试玩。
Website/package checks passed; full physical-iPad play remains the final gate.

title: 从双版本测评进入融合验证
Turn comparison into a merge experiment
summary: 先选要借鉴的模块，再验证一个小的融合样例，不直接把两套代码拼起来。
Choose modules first, then validate a small integration sample instead of concatenating the codebases.
brief: Claude 的主动飞行＋Astra 的地面反馈。
Claude’s active flight plus Astra’s ground feedback.
tool: 建议：统一动作接口 → 接一个登陆战斗样例 → 两指与冰火回归
Proposed: common action interface → one landing/battle slice → touch and ice/fire regression
tech: 以 move/look/fire/ice/jump/pause 为接口，关卡状态与战斗实现解耦
Use move/look/fire/ice/jump/pause interfaces to separate stage flow from combat
result: 这是下一轮建议，尚未制作融合版，也没有替换两个现行版本。
This is a proposal, not an implemented merge; both current builds remain.

left: 主动操控母舰，避小行星并换乘降落
Active mothership, asteroids, transfer and descent
right: 航行以过场为主，主动探索较少
Mostly cinematic travel, little active exploration
direction: 融合时采用 Claude 的阶段骨架

left: 原始转向/横移混合；现已分离但待实机手感反馈
Turning/strafe were mixed; revised but feel awaits device feedback
right: 第三人称移动与冰火反馈较直接
More direct third-person and ice/fire feedback
direction: 将 Astra 的操作响应做成统一动作接口
Use Astra-style response through one action interface

left: 冰冻普通/巨型火球，接完整关卡旅程
Freeze ordinary/giant fireballs within the journey
right: 战斗演示和动作反馈更集中
direction: 统一命中提示、冷却和两指操作
Unify hit cues, cooldowns and two-finger input

left: 当前阶段重试，不强迫重飞全部航程
Retry the current stage, not the whole voyage
direction: 保留关卡检查点，与战斗状态隔离
Keep checkpoints separate from combat state

left: 已接左侧栏和手势保护，实体长流程待测
Left rail and gesture guard; hardware full-flow pending
right: 同样有单机、触屏和双语
direction: 把同一套验收用于融合样例
Use the same test gates on the merge slice

merge_steps: 锁定两份当前版本，先在 iPad 对照飞行、移动、冰冻和失败重试。
Freeze both current builds and compare flight, movement, ice and retry on iPad.
以 Claude 关卡流程为主，抽出统一的移动／转视角／攻击接口，不直接粘合两个 game.js。
Use Claude’s stage flow and extract common movement/look/attack interfaces; do not paste two game.js files together.
只接通“降落 → 一波怪 → 冰冻大火球 → 重试”的小样，确认手感比任一旧版更好。
Integrate only landing → one wave → giant-fireball freeze → retry; check that the feel improves.
通过双指、暂停、连点防缩放和关卡回归后，再扩成完整融合版。
Expand into a full merge only after multi-touch, pause, no-zoom and stage regression pass.
next_scope: 当前发布的是两个对照版本；融合方案待你看完测评后决定，不提前替换。
Two comparison builds are published; the merge awaits review and does not replace them yet.

harrison-zavier.name: Harrison × Zavier
title: 石剪布 · 怪物突袭
RPS · Monster Rush
heroTitle:
判断克制
一起撑过怪物突袭

Match the monster
Survive the rush together
intro: 战士破甲，法师对付水晶怪，战斗机追击快怪。宝箱放在最终胜利之后，大招用于解围，队友帮忙但不能替玩家赢。
Fighter breaks armor, Mage handles crystal enemies, and Jet catches runners. The chest rewards victory; supers are emergency tools, and teammates support rather than carry.
decision: 版本取舍已确定：Opus 两次修复后仍有课堂使用 Bug，停止投入；保留 Astra，继续改善移动、队友和 Boss 平衡。
Decision made: Opus still had classroom-use bugs after two repairs, so stop investing. Keep Astra and improve movement, bots and boss balance.

name: A · 当前可玩版
A · Current playable build
tag: 保留 · 手感与平衡修订
subtitle: 一名玩家＋两名电脑队友，单机即可进入完整战斗。
One player and two bot teammates. Start a full battle locally.
detail: 角色与镜头采用同一连续位置、按时间平滑；电脑普通攻击间隔变为 1.8 倍，每波最多一次大招。Boss 更耐打，并提前标出定点砸击。
Character and camera share a continuous position with time-based smoothing. Bot attack intervals are 1.8× longer, with at most one super per wave. The tougher boss telegraphs targeted slams.
strength: 保留职业克制、三阶段 Boss 和宝箱结局，浏览器本地单机不依赖课堂联机服务。
Retain role counters, a three-phase boss and the treasure ending. Local solo does not depend on the classroom multiplayer service.
limit: 这是单机家庭版，不把它当作“三台 iPad 联机已验收”。平衡模拟也不是学生胜率统计。
This is the home solo build, not certification of three-iPad networking. Balance simulations are not student win-rate data.

name: B · 课堂弃用候选

detail: 记录中出现错误服务端口，以及移动、名字输入和多人同步问题。已有局部脚本与截图，但没有完成可用的三 iPad 端到端课堂闭环。两次修复仍失败的结论来自教师复盘。

Records show the wrong service port, movement problems, name-entry issues and multiplayer state trouble. Local scripts and screenshots exist, but they did not establish a usable three-iPad classroom session. The two-failed-repairs conclusion comes from the teacher’s review.

requirements: 角色与表达
Roles & expression
Minecraft 风格 3D；孩子自己输入名字，选择战士、法师或战斗机。
Minecraft-inspired 3D. Children enter a name and choose Fighter, Mage or Jet.
克制与大招
Counters & supers
石头护甲、魔法水晶、绿色快怪有对应克制。熔岩拳、火焰环、炸弹轰炸用于解围，不应一直释放。
Stone armor, magic crystals and green runners have role counters. Lava Punch, Fire Ring and Bomb Strike are emergency tools, not unlimited spam.
视角与流程
View & flow
默认第三人称、可切第一人称。普通波次 → 精英波次 → 三阶段 Boss → 宝箱胜利。
Third-person by default, with first-person switching. Normal waves → elite wave → three-phase boss → treasure victory.
课堂与家庭的区别
Classroom versus home
课堂原需求为三个孩子各用一台 iPad。家庭版明确改为一人＋两名电脑队友，不把静态单机发布冒称已解决多人联机。
The original classroom requested three separate iPads. The home build explicitly uses one human plus two bots. Static solo delivery is not claimed as a networking fix.
本轮调整
This revision
走路不要发卡；电脑别代打；后期有败局可能，Boss 需要主动躲避。
Reduce walking judder. Bots should support rather than carry. Late waves can fail, and the boss requires active dodging.
timeline: 形成最终 brief：三个职业、克制、大招冷却、第三／第一人称和波次战斗。
Final brief defines three roles, counters, cooldowns, camera modes and waves.
明确课堂是三个学生各用一台 iPad，不是同屏共享键盘。
Clarify three students on three iPads, not a shared keyboard.
Opus 分支服务入口不对；教师指出端口并非预期的 8123。
The Opus service entry is wrong; the teacher reports that it is not the expected port 8123.
教师反馈无法移动、名字不能正常输入、内容跳动／重复，联机服务仍有问题。
Teacher reports failure to move, broken name entry, jumping/duplicated state and continued service problems.
DECISION
按教师复盘，两次修复后仍不能用，课堂选择舍弃 Opus，保留 Astra。局部测试不抵消实际课堂失败。
According to teacher review, two repairs still did not make it usable. Reject Opus and retain Astra. Local tests do not override classroom failure.
R3
在已选分支上修正镜头跟随、减少电脑攻击与大招频率，增强 Boss；模拟过难后再校准，而非反复抽新版本。
Improve the selected branch: camera follow, less frequent bot attacks and supers, stronger boss. Recalibrate an over-hard first pass rather than repeatedly generating new candidates.
R4 · TOUCH
工具栏统一改为左侧竖排，为摇杆留出独立空间；增加游戏表面的防双击缩放与非被动触摸防护，不影响普通按钮和名字输入。
Move utilities to a vertical left rail with a separate joystick zone; add gesture CSS and non-passive touch protection on game surfaces while preserving normal controls and name entry.
changes: 走路发卡
Walking judder
角色按帧插值、镜头却跟随离散状态，两个位置不同步。现在镜头跟随已平滑的角色位置，插值系数也按真实时间计算。
Character interpolation and camera following used different positions. The camera now follows the smoothed character, and interpolation depends on elapsed time.
电脑过强
Bots carry the game
普攻间隔 ×1.8，频率约减少 44%；大招每波最多 1 次且冷却翻倍；目标判断每 0.7 秒更新。保留对倒地队友的救援。
Normal attack intervals ×1.8, roughly 44% lower frequency. At most one super per wave with doubled cooldown, and target decisions every 0.7 seconds. Teammate rescue remains.
Boss 过于轻松
Boss lacks pressure
每阶段血量 340 → 440；接触伤害 19 → 22；砸击伤害 34 → 40。先标记玩家位置，再延迟落地，留出躲避时间。
Phase HP 340 → 440; contact damage 19 → 22; slam damage 34 → 40. Mark the player’s position before a delayed impact so dodging is possible.
不要把难度改成堵死
Avoid an unfair difficulty wall
首轮削弱过重、测试全败，已回调队友单次伤害和精英密度。保留后期失败可能与三职业阶段条件。
The first pass was too harsh and all simulations failed. Restore bot per-hit damage and reduce elite density while retaining possible late failure and all three required boss roles.
工具栏遮挡与双击缩放
Toolbar overlap and double-tap zoom
三个保留版本使用左侧工具栏。游戏手势不再交给浏览器缩放，双指移动、攻击和普通按钮另行回归。
All three retained builds use the left utility rail. Game gestures are protected from browser zoom; multi-touch play and ordinary controls are checked separately.
guide: 输入名字、选择职业，点开始单机，再点开始战斗。左摇杆移动；右侧攻击可按住，大招按钮只在合适时使用。拖动画面转视角，可切第一／第三人称。红圈标出 Boss 砸击的位置：尽快移开。靠近倒地队友能更快救起；全队倒下会失败，可重试。

Enter a name, choose a role, select Play Solo, then Start the Rush. Move with the left stick; hold Attack and save your super for the right moment. Drag to look and switch first/third person. Move out of the boss’s red impact marker. Nearby teammates revive faster. If the whole team falls, retry.
questions: 哪种怪物应该交给哪位英雄？
什么时候该留大招，什么时候该救队友？
When should you save a super or rescue a teammate?
为什么有画面、但课堂不能用的版本要舍弃？
Why reject a version with attractive visuals when it does not work in class?

title: 把“宝箱＋猜拳”变成职业克制

Three roles/enemy types, super cooldowns, five waves and a three-phase boss

Define the full loop from name entry to treasure victory.

title: 并行实现，但选择不同的集成方式
Implement in parallel with different integration choices
summary: 两边都有 15 分钟限制；课堂同时明确每人一台 iPad。
Both had a 15-minute limit; the class also clarified one iPad per player.
brief: 第三人称优先，可切第一人称；三人要进入同一场战斗。
Third-person first, optional first-person; three players share one battle.

Claude: Bash/Workflow contracts and modules; Astra: exec writes engine, client and server

Three.js voxel world; Node.js/WebSocket classroom service; separate rules and rendering

Two candidates: modular Opus and Astra with a separate rules engine.

title: Opus 两次修复后仍未通过课堂使用
Opus remains unusable in class after two repairs

18:25 reports a wrong service entry; 18:32 reports no movement, blocked A entry and inconsistent names.
brief: 教师反馈：“我们不能在名字里面输 A”；这是输入与联机链路，不只是美术问题。
Teacher feedback reports that A cannot be entered in names; this is input/network integration, not an art issue.
tool: 检查端口/服务 → 输入框与移动脚本自检 → 连接和加入逻辑修复 → 回归
Check service → input/movement scripts → repair join/connection logic → regression
tech: 表单焦点与游戏按键隔离、多人身份/状态同步、入口与缓存
Separate form/game keys, synchronize identities/state, fix entry and cache
result: 虽然日志里有局部测试，教师复盘仍判定两次修复后不能用；停止投入并弃用。
Local tests exist, but teacher review still reports failure after two repairs. Stop investing and reject it.

title: Astra 先交付战斗，再修当堂 iPad 显示
Astra delivers combat, then fixes iPad display
summary: 先完成波次与职业；当堂反馈强调的是全屏和页面被放大后看不到内容。
Complete waves/roles first; the classroom feedback then identifies fullscreen and zoom hiding the game.
brief: 18:39 反馈：这版不是不能移动，而是 iPad 缩放后看不全。
18:39 clarification: this build can move, but iPad zoom obscures the view.

Engine tests → browser/screenshots → quick-skill fix → display.js/WebKit checks
tech: engine.mjs 规则；Three.js 客户端；显示模块管理 viewport 与全屏
engine.mjs rules, Three.js client, viewport/fullscreen display module
result: 保留 Astra，课堂原型窗口延续到显示修复；不把后续空闲会话时间算进去。
Retain Astra; its classroom window includes the display repair, not later idle session time.

title: 拆掉单机对课堂服务器的依赖
Remove solo dependence on the classroom server
summary: 家里不应该等老师开电脑或凑齐队友。
Home play should not require the teacher’s computer or a full team.
brief: 一名真人＋两名电脑，也能走完波次与 Boss。
One human and two bots can run the wave/boss loop.
tool: 接本地传输适配 → 验证本地引擎 → 断网继续 → 打包
Add local transport → check engine → continue offline → package
tech: solo-transport.mjs 复用 engine.mjs；静态页面运行，素材本地化
solo-transport.mjs reuses engine.mjs in a static page with bundled assets
result: 家庭单机可发布；三台实体 iPad 联机不被混写成已通过。
Publish home solo without claiming three-device network acceptance.

title: 让玩家重新承担走位和技能选择
Restore player responsibility for movement and skills
summary: 教师发现走路发卡、Bot 太强、Boss 压力不足。
Teacher identifies walking judder, overly strong bots and a weak boss.
brief: 队友能帮忙，也会倒下；大招用于解围，Boss 要主动躲。
Bots help but can fall; save supers and actively dodge the boss.
tool: 检查镜头位置 → 降低 Bot 频率 → 加强 Boss → 规则回归和固定策略模拟
Inspect camera → reduce bot frequency → strengthen boss → regression and seeded simulation
tech: 按时间平滑；Bot 普攻间隔 ×1.8，每波最多一次大招；预警砸击
Time-based smoothing; bot intervals ×1.8, one super per wave; telegraphed slam
result: 模拟主动策略可胜可败，不操作策略全败；不把模拟统计当作孩子胜率。
Active scripted runs include wins and losses; idle runs lose. These are not child win rates.

title: 共用左侧工具栏，保留清楚的版本结论
Share the left toolbar and preserve the decision
summary: 加入防连点缩放与侧栏，避免挡住说明和按键；这次去掉右侧三词句号。
Add a left rail and repeated-tap protection; remove periods from the three right-side words in this review.
brief: 移动／选择／生存；可直接进入保留的单机版本。
Move / Choose / Survive; enter the retained solo build directly.
tool: 侧栏/手势回归 → 单机包核验 → 全程开发记录与可视化
Rail/gesture regression → package verification → complete visual development history
tech: 共用 device-kit、手势防护、双语页面、预算与阶段数据
Shared device kit, gesture protection, bilingual pages and budget/stage data
result: 当前待实机与展示确认；Opus 只留失败原因和成本，不重新包装成可玩版。
Await physical-device and presentation approval; Opus remains a documented rejection, not a playable release.

next_scope: 接下来验证保留版本的实机手感与后期难度。只有另行决定恢复联机开发，才重开三台 iPad 的端到端任务。
Next validate hardware feel and late-game difficulty in the retained build. Reopen three-iPad end-to-end work only with a separate networking decision.
rejection: 这是已经完成的取舍，不是还等两版竞赛：Opus 两次修复后仍未满足当堂可玩要求，停止投入。保留失败证据与 A$10.78 的工具投入，不发布试玩按钮。

This decision is complete, not an open contest: after two repairs Opus still failed classroom usability. Stop spending, preserve the failure evidence and A$10.78 tool cost, and provide no play button.
